item.title: Designing XSLT transforms with parameters and multiple inputs
item.description: Many real-world transformations do not run on a single XML document. You often merge a primary payload with reference data, catalog lookups, or environment configuration. Done well, this results in a clean, predictable transform. Done poorly, it becomes a maze of document() calls and hidden dependencies. The difference is in how you model inputs and parameters from the start. As an integration engineer, I treat input selection and parameter design as first-class API design for the stylesheet.
